card.name: Employment discrimination law dates and limits
card.fires_on: Spaces, numbers and small linking words inside text on US employment discrimination laws (EEOC, Title VII, Age Discrimination Act). It marks spots just before a year or a day count, such as 'of' before 1967 or a space before 300 days.

modes.label: Day counts
modes.description: The space or digit just before a number of days in filing-deadline text.

modes.label: Act years
modes.description: The word 'of' or a digit within a year after the name of a civil rights or labor act.
modes.example: Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act<< of>> 2008 GINA

modes.label: Stray web text
modes.description: Scattered spots in URLs or citations, such as an equals sign or a name before an initial.

card.plain: It fires in legal text about job discrimination laws, just before a year or a number of days.
